$comment: 漂移报告。由漂移检测步骤在每个观测周期产出。verdict 驱动路由：NO_DRIFT -> 继续；COMPATIBLE_DRIFT -> 继续 + 向下游治理报告告警；BREAKING_DRIFT -> 挂起受影响用例 + 强制人工评审检查点。IR 绝不会基于本报告自动更新。

findings.drift_kind: FIELD_ADDED | FIELD_REMOVED | TYPE_WIDENED | TYPE_NARROWED | TYPE_CHANGED | STATE_ADDED | STATE_REMOVED | TRANSITION_ADDED | TRANSITION_REMOVED

routing: 人类可读的、按 verdict 给出的路由说明
